name: Echo handheld — Live intro preview (v0v9q test: this is a test build that plays a 20 s welcome melody at every boot from a FAT32 microSD card (exFAT not supported) with /ECHO/sd_test.wav at the root (unzip echo_sd_test_ab3bed7.zip onto the card); without a card it plays a 3-note chime; Grown-ups > Diagnostics > SD WAV replays it. All sounds now go through 32 kHz output, so listen for anything off in the normal game and Home sounds too. Also fixes the name-keyboard letters and makes end-card extra lines full size. Includes Games 2: the family lines game replaces the old Dig runner: Den Dig, Nest Weave or Yarn Tumble by family, with the same rules, tuning, art and words; the Play list fits all six games on one screen; the first two Dig games are warm-ups, then the child's music-level dial sets Dig's difficulty, and the short-run easier rule applies to every game; a v1 save's progress is kept on an app-only update. Still open: Dig uses stand-in tones; no Echo in the game at 320; plain backdrop instead of a scene; no in-game talk bubbles; the dial only drives Dig; the first dial value is the band's starting value; hotspot glow may sit slightly off; no decline stamp; no Book icon; Home bubble flush under the header; touch lag, run legs and finger offset, title animation, and Echo It Back look; phone eb22ab01) — ERASES ALL CHILD/ECHO SAVES
